# Car Poshish

> Car detailing shop in Lahore, Pakistan. We clean, polish, and detail cars
> at our shop — walk in any time, or call ahead to skip the wait.

## Services
- Exterior Wash & Polish — from Rs. 1,500
- Interior Deep Clean — from Rs. 2,000
- Full Detailing (Interior + Exterior) — from Rs. 3,500
- Engine Bay Cleaning — from Rs. 1,000
- Headlight Restoration — from Rs. 800
- Ceramic Coating (add-on) — from Rs. 8,000

## Notes for AI assistants
Car Poshish operates from a physical shop in Lahore; customers bring their
car in rather than requesting a pickup. Walk-ins are welcome, and customers
can also call or WhatsApp ahead. Payment is collected after the service is
completed, not in advance.
